learn_source: Watch the blacksmith join two pieces of the Lantern Arch centerpiece at the bench in the Town scene
confirm_action: Cast it yourself on a broken thing once
mana_effect: Quality only: at high mana the seam closes invisibly; at baseline the join holds but a hairline shows. Never whether the cast is possible.

receivers.physical_outcome: The crack seals along its length; the pane holds light again
no_effect — there is no break to close
State-dependent: two fitted halves held together join at the seam; halves held apart or misaligned take no join — the spell closes a seam, it does not assemble
No physical effect — living receivers never catch; the wing is not mended

receivers.reaction_kind: steady appraisal — she mends by hand and watches what the spell failed to do
